description: A status qualifies if its average model confidence exceeds the average model confidence taken over every individual compliance case.

d.request: For each distinct broker reporting status (treating missing values as a distinct status), calculate average model confidence (ignoring missing model confidence values), filter to statuses exceeding the overall average model confidence, and report each with: status, average model confidence, difference from overall average, and average divided by the mean of all qualifying statuses' averages.
d.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as overall_avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL') as status,
    AVG(modelconf) as avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL')
),
qualified_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.status,
    sa.avg_conf,
    oa.overall_avg_conf,
    sa.avg_conf - oa.overall_avg_conf as diff_from_overall
  FROM status_avg sa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE sa.avg_conf > oa.overall_avg_conf
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_conf) as mean_qualifying
  FROM qualified_statuses
)
SELECT 
  qs.status,
  qs.avg_conf as average_model_confidence,
  qs.diff_from_overall as difference_from_overall_average,
  qs.avg_conf / mq.mean_qualifying as average_divided_by_mean
FROM qualified_statuses qs, mean_of_qualifying mq
ORDER BY qs.status

c.request: Which broker reporting statuses (`brokrepstat`) have above-average model confidence (`modelconf`)? Treat cases with no status as their own status. For each one, show the status, its average model confidence, how far above average it is, and its average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Ignore missing values when averaging, return nothing if a reference value is missing, and don't round. A status qualifies if its average model confidence exceeds the average model confidence taken over every individual compliance case.
c.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) as overall_average FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL') as status, AVG(modelconf) as status_average FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL')), qualifying AS (SELECT sa.status, sa.status_average, oa.overall_average FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.status_average > oa.overall_average), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_average) as mean_of_qualifying_averages FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.status_average as avg_modelconf, q.status_average - q.overall_average as above_average, q.status_average / qm.mean_of_qualifying_averages as relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm WHERE q.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND qm.mean_of_qualifying_averages IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.status

a.request: Group the compliance cases by broker reporting status (`brokrepstat`), treating cases with no status as their own group, and find each status's average model confidence (`modelconf`). For the baseline, take the average model confidence computed directly over every individual compliance case, so statuses with more cases weigh more. Which statuses have an average above that baseline? For each, show the status, its average model confidence, its average minus the baseline, and its average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if either reference value is missing. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) as baseline_avg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL), status_avgs AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) as status_avg FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), with_baseline AS (SELECT sa.brokrepstat, sa.status_avg, b.baseline_avg FROM status_avgs sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.status_avg > b.baseline_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying FROM with_baseline) SELECT wb.brokrepstat, wb.status_avg, wb.status_avg - wb.baseline_avg, wb.status_avg / qm.mean_of_qualifying FROM with_baseline wb CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm WHERE qm.mean_of_qualifying IS NOT NULL

b.request: For each broker reporting status (including NULL as a distinct status), filter to those whose average model confidence exceeds the global average model confidence across all compliance cases, then report each qualifying status with its average confidence, its difference from the global average, and its average divided by the mean of all qualifying statuses' averages.
b.sql:
WITH global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as global_avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) as avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
qualifying_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.brokrepstat,
    sa.avg_conf,
    ga.global_avg_conf
  FROM status_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
  WHERE sa.avg_conf > ga.global_avg_conf
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_conf) as mean_of_qualifying
  FROM qualifying_statuses
)
SELECT 
  qs.brokrepstat,
  qs.avg_conf as average_confidence,
  qs.avg_conf - qs.global_avg_conf as difference_from_global,
  qs.avg_conf / qm.mean_of_qualifying as avg_divided_by_mean_of_qualifying
FROM qualifying_statuses qs
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
ORDER BY qs.brokrepstat
b.raw: For each broker reporting status (including NULL as a distinct status), filter to those whose average model confidence exceeds the global average model confidence across all compliance cases, then report each qualifying status with its average confidence, its difference from the global average, and its average divided by the mean of all qualifying statuses' averages.
